title: Fibre Channel: Fix reassembly with a NULL tree
description:
Reassembly cannot be skipped with a NULL tree, because on a second pass,
even with a visible tree, the results from the first pass will be used.
We also change the INFO column in this branch, and dissection of the
columns can be done with a NULL tree.

Also, do not add the reassembled data to every single frame that
contributes to the reassembly, only the last one.

Fixes reassembly in situations other than single pass tshark with a
visible tree.

Also fix the identation in the nearby paragraph.

AI-Assisted: no
